scientific_integrity: The theorem is a finite counting consequence of the explicit structural Theorem 5.9 in arXiv:2605.00041. General proof by compatible-pair double counting; independent finite tests on direct generator composition in degrees two and three, paired-partition enumeration through five, formula through six. No independent audit.
scientific_limitations: Only full finite transformation monoids T_X are covered.
The base rank is the size of the canonical partial-bijection component, not the cardinality of the partial automorphism domain in T_X.
The result relies on the published classification of compatible pairs and does not give a new classification.
An earlier source manuscript dating to 2023 contained related material; versions not fully retrieved remain an originality risk.
The verifier only checks finitely many n.
title: Exact base-rank census for partial inner automorphisms of finite full transformation monoids
